A flaw in the CORS plugin allowed the incoming request's `Vary` header to be reflected into the response, letting a client influence a header that should be controlled solely by the server.

### Details
The CORS plugin previously copied the request's `Vary` header directly onto the response instead of treating `Vary` as a response-only header. Because `Vary` tells downstream caches and proxies how to key their cached responses, this allowed a client to inject arbitrary values into the response's `Vary` header, potentially distorting cache-key behavior in shared caches/CDNs sitting in front of an oRPC server and leading to inconsistent CORS enforcement for other clients.

Practical impact is limited to deployments where a shared cache or reverse proxy keys on the `Vary` header; the real-world effect depends on the caching layer's configuration.

### Impact
May cause cache key pollution and inconsistent CORS enforcement in setups that rely on shared/edge caches keying on `Vary`. No direct confidentiality, integrity, or availability impact in default (non-cached) configurations.

### Resolution
Update `@orpc/server` (and any other `@orpc/*` packages bundling the CORS plugin) to `1.14.8`. The CORS plugin now derives `Vary` exclusively from the response, appending `Origin` and preserving existing values instead of reflecting request headers.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-17T14:52:37Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-77360"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-09-16T19:17:38Z", "published_at": "2026-09-17T14:52:37Z", "references": ["https://github.com/middleapi/orpc/security/advisories/GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77360", "https://github.com/middleapi/orpc/issues/1661", "https://github.com/middleapi/orpc/pull/1662", "https://github.com/middleapi/orpc/commit/daabded122a89d323357c4c401e879701864cb2f", "https://github.com/middleapi/orpc/releases/tag/v1.14.8", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/middleapi/orpc/security-advisories/GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/middleapi/orpc", "summary": "oRPC: Vary Header Injection in CORS Plugin leading to potential Cache/CORS Bypass", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-17T14:52:41Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-j9v4-rhgr-4m5f", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.14.8", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@orpc/server"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.14.7"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
